mechanics.claim: Empowered attacks in Stampede Stance have an uncancellable windup and dash onto the target if not already in range.
mechanics.quote: empowering his basic attacks to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and {{tt|{{tip|dash|pounce}} on the target|to 75 units closer than attack range, if Udyr is not closer already (pending for test)}} to {{tip|stun}} them

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack still applies its effects even if the dash is interrupted, but does not trigger or get consumed on structures, wards, or if parried.
mechanics.quote:
The empowered attack will still apply its effects even if the dash is interrupted.
* The empowered attacks will not trigger nor be consumed if they hit a structure or ward or are parried.

mechanics.claim: Each empowered attack is its own cast instance, meaning on-hit/on-cast effects tied to distinct casts apply separately.
mechanics.quote: Each empowered attack is considered to belong to its own {{tip|cast instance}}.

mechanics.claim: Udyr becomes ghosted and gains movement speed for 4 seconds while in this stance, unrelated to damage output.

mechanics.claim: Recasting the ability refreshes its cooldown instead of starting a new one from a fixed point.
